crossRefs.note: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.
But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.
for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.
Yahweh, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.
How long, Yahweh? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
“In a very little while, he who comes will come, and will not wait.
He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.

translations.web: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Yahweh, don’t delay.
translations.bsb: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
translations.kjv: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
translations.asv: But I am poor and needy; Make haste unto me, O God: Thou art my help and my deliverer; O Jehovah, make no tarrying.
